title.en: Precise coat styling and breed grooming

text.en: Reviewers consistently praise the high aesthetic quality of full haircuts, breed-specific styling, and express nail trims. Pet parents of double-coated breeds and poodles note that their dogs return looking neatly trimmed and beautifully finished after appointments on Amwell Street.

Dog owners highlight the warm, polite, and accommodating customer service delivered by the salon team. Clients describe feeling welcomed upon arrival and appreciate groomers who communicate clearly about styling preferences and take time to ensure each visit runs smoothly.

title.en: Patient care for lively companion dogs

text.en: Clients note that groomers demonstrate great patience with energetic, boisterous, or sensitive dogs during grooming sessions. Owners of Pomeranians, toy poodles, and spaniels express strong confidence leaving their pets, noting that dogs remain calm throughout styling.

q.en: Does Mon Joli Chien handle double-coated dog breeds?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the groomers have specific expertise with double-coated breeds like Pomeranians, taking care to protect coat health and texture.

q.en: Can pet owners book standalone nail clipping sessions?

a.en: Clients mention quick and efficient standalone services, including nail clipping appointments, without needing a full groom.

q.en: Where is the grooming salon located?

a.en: Mon Joli Chien is situated on Amwell Street in the Finsbury and Clerkenwell area of Islington.

q.en: What dog sizes and coat types are accepted?

a.en: The salon accommodates dogs of all sizes, offering puppy visits, full coat styling, and gentle hand-stripping treatments.
